title: kithd: structured logging with tracing
description: Create kithd::logging module with init_logging() and a request tracing layer. Add tracing-subscriber (with env-filter, json features) and tower-http (with trace feature) to workspace Cargo.toml and kithd Cargo.toml. init_logging(): detect TTY on stderr; TTY → fmt human-readable; non-TTY → fmt JSON for systemd journal. Both use RUST_LOG env var, defaulting to 'kithd=info,kith_peer=info'. Add request_tracing_layer() to lib.rs and wire it into build_app via .layer(). Never log request/response bodies or message content.
